candidates.spoken: A gas pipeline exploded under a California neighbourhood.
Fire destroyed dozens of homes, and eight people were killed.
The San Bruno gas pipeline exploded under a residential neighbourhood.
When pressure rose, the weld tore open.
Company records said it was seamless.
Escaping gas ignited in a huge fireball.
The pipe section had been installed in 1956.
In reality, it had a badly made weld.
Operators then had to verify records and pressure-test old lines.
a pressure rise on a pipe with a defective weld.
It started with defective pipe section in 1956. It ended with gas ignites.

script.spoken: A gas pipeline exploded under a California neighbourhood. Fire destroyed dozens of homes, and eight people were killed. The pipe section had been installed in 1956. Company records said it was seamless. In reality, it had a badly made weld. When pressure rose, the weld tore open. Escaping gas ignited in a huge fireball. Operators then had to verify records and pressure-test old lines.
